data.body: Phase 2 found agent-task-rewake blindspots: terminal task with missing/deleted tracking can still nag, dead-PID mid-task waits until the 30min timeout, and legitimately slow or permission/queen-waiting tasks trigger TASK CHECK DUE spam. This is in protected .claude/helpers/agent-task-rewake.cjs, so Claude may route protected patches to Codex if needed.
data.title: P2-SH4-SH5-SL1 harden agent-task rewake for terminal dead and waiting tasks
